description: This file defines a class 'Tracking' that contains nested classes 'Tracker' and 'Task' to monitor and manage Android activity lifecycle events within an application. It tracks task and activity states, handles activity resume and destruction events, and maintains an ordered list of tasks and their activities.

classes.name: Tracking
classes.description: Main class providing activity and task tracking functionality, including nested classes for managing tasks and activities.

classes.name: Tracking.Tracker
classes.description: Maintains a mapping of task IDs to tasks, ordered tasks, and listeners to track activity lifecycle events such as resume and destroy, and manage task activity order.

classes.name: Tracking.Task
classes.description: Represents a task with an ID and a list of associated activities, providing methods to manage activities within the task.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles activity resume event; updates task and activity order, checks and moves activities if their task IDs have changed, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Handles activity destruction; removes activity from its task; deletes empty tasks.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current number of tracked tasks.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a listener to be notified when task list changes.

methods.name: activityResumed
methods.description: Updated in Task class; moves the resume activity to the most recent position within its task.

methods.name: activityDestroyed
methods.description: Updated in Task class; removes the destroyed activity from its task.
